Acquires {{summary.l8_15.acquisition}}/384 on SELECT-VIEWS-001 against Titan-Sparse's {{summary.sparse.acquisition}} (same run) with {{summary.l8_15.floors_cleared}}/3 families clearing their published floors; arithmetic {{summary.l8_15.arithmetic_permissive}}/150 permissive and {{summary.l8_15.arithmetic_strict}}/150 strict; {{summary.l8_15.retained}} of 47 source answers retained; first-token KL drift against Supa {{drift.drift_fresh.ratio_l8_15_over_sparse.kl_arm_supa.ratio}}x Titan-Sparse's on 456 fresh prompts. delta_donor.note: No new training. The delta is Titan-Sparse's (itself the top-25% magnitude prune of the RRP-015 control update, seed 17); this core changes only where it is kept.

construction.candidate_provenance: RCWM-T1 R12 (patching, D-21) and R14 (D-23 localisation test) on the RCWM pilot bank and 248 off-task prompts; no decisive endpoint reads either (228 of the 248 enter only the anchors' C0 log-prob parity leg and a report-only bridge ratio)
construction.formula: theta_supa + 1[block in 8..15] * (theta_titan_sparse - theta_supa); the delta is exactly zero in the embeddings, the final norm and blocks 0-7 (verified element by element at build, gate B2)
construction.reproducible_from: Supa 962abc5b... + Titan-Sparse a28629c9... via RCWM-T1 scripts/l1_screen.py build
construction.reproducibility_verified: two independent derivations and a re-read of the written file agree byte for byte (B3); per-group FP32 hashes equal RCWM-T1 R14's measured loc8_15 arm (B4)

storage_format_deviation.family_convention: every core in this vault except the Titan-Sparse lineage stores BF16
storage_format_deviation.why: Blocks 8-15 hold Titan-Sparse's FP32 tensors, whose identity is a magnitude-selected 0.056%-relative update; BF16 storage would erase much of it (measured for the parent: 28.49% of kept delta elements rounded to zero).
storage_format_deviation.config_torch_dtype: float32, so that torch_dtype='auto' cannot silently cast this core to BF16. The only sidecar that differs from Supa 1.7.0-devfreeze.
storage_format_deviation.evidence_copy_note: The measured arm (runs/l1_screen/arm-l8_15) kept Supa's byte-identical config.json (the programme's measured-arm convention). That arm and this core differ only in that file.

environment.forward: the programme's DenseReference, vendored byte-exact from pilot commit 5b4c22d

measured.comparability: C0 held: scorers reproduce every published per-row verdict on the decisive instruments; Supa and Titan-Sparse, re-measured in the same run, passed the anchor parity gate before L8-15 was loaded ({{parity_gate.legs}}); transformers 5.14.1, a named deviation from SPARSE-001's matched-environment stop rule

off_task_drift.instrument: 456 fresh preservation-slice prompts (57 reply classes x 8), disjoint in id, template family and text from R14's 248 and from every id and user text of the HSKILL-002 source pools; spent for confirmation by this use

long_context.instrument_status: SPENT; barred TRAIN/SELECTION/CONFIRMATION; REPORT-ONLY, did NOT select this core

abstention.parent_confirmed_damage: RCI-001 (spent 1/1): Titan-Sparse 25/128 vs Supa 40/128 literal UNKNOWN, p = 6.1e-5; not measured for this core

limitations: ONE training draw; the delta direction is RRP-015's single seed. Splicing cannot manufacture replication.
The 8-15 cut was chosen post hoc from exploratory pilot data; only the promotion decision was preregistered.
Every decisive instrument is selection-grade; no confirmation of acquisition, retention, drift, long context or abstention exists.
The parent's literal-UNKNOWN abstention damage is confirmed (RCI-001); this core's is unmeasured beyond a report-only 64-row count.
Off-task drift (first-token KL) is a proxy for forgetting.
Long context and abstention are report-only on a SPENT suite.
Stored and evaluated FP32. Native BF16 serving is NOT qualified; a BF16 copy is a different model.
Semantic abstention review NOT_PERFORMED. Human data review of the training corpus NOT_PERFORMED.

selection_instruments: 150-row arithmetic panel and the 47 source answers
